about: Same five-step ladder as reviews.json (see its 'about'). {X} = the name he picks or types; {a}/{plural} = the kind of thing. 'against' marks the other side (the empty square on the card). · 7 Nov 2026: each slot has a 'label' (what the student sees: First reason, Second reason …) and a q that names the job exactly — 'adds a reason' was true of the other side too. · 22 Nov 2026: the first option in each slot is the essay's core set (the Guided essays and card 1): Few people would deny that / Firstly, it is often argued that the main advantage of / Secondly, it is widely believed that another point in favour of / On the other hand, it must be acknowledged that one serious drawback of / On balance, I believe that. · 25 Nov 2026 (the owner, after the content check): every way is a phrase the task's own model texts use (the Model and Guided/Sample steps), three alternatives per move, the moves in the models' order, so Basics teaches what the practice shows.
name: Essay
how: An essay in five sentences, as the Guided essays build it: introduce the topic, your first point, your second point, your own idea, and your conclusion.

nameAsk.title: Which one?
nameAsk.aim: Pick a topic you have an opinion on. You’ll write about it.

notebook: Write your essay on {X} in five sentences, one per slot. Then check:
ticks: My first sentence introduces the topic.
Each reason has an example of my own.
My conclusion says clearly what I think.

slots.q: Which one makes your first point?

ways.t: Firstly, there is no doubt that …
Firstly, it is often argued that …
Firstly, it is widely believed that …

slots.label: First point

slots.job: make your second point, or show the other side
slots.q: Which one makes your second point?

ways.t: Secondly, it is often argued that …
Secondly, it is widely believed that …
On the other hand, it must be acknowledged that …

slots.label: Second point

slots.q: Which one adds your own idea?

ways.t: Finally, it seems to me that …
Finally, it seems to me that another key point is that …

slots.label: Your own idea

ways.t: All things considered, I firmly believe that …
